digest: src/ 파일 3개(workflow-stop.ts, workflow-cancellation.ts, workflow-terminal.ts)와 SPEC.md 대응 구현을 매핑했다. 테스트 파일은 저장소에 없다.

implementationMap.component: Stop detection: intent and launch-signal check
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Stop is detected from the disk intent (readWorkflowStopIntent) or from a launch-registered AbortSignal that has aborted. Both are checked in createWorkflowStopSignal and throwIfWorkflowStopRequested.

implementationMap.evidence: error.name = WORKFLOW_STOP_REQUESTED_ERROR_NAME; return `workflow stop requested for ${runId}`;
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Creates an Error named WorkflowStopRequested with message 'workflow stop requested for <runId>'.
Also accepts errors by message prefix, not only by name.
Default poll is 200ms and the floor is 1ms; the code does not match the spec's default of 50ms or 10ms minimum.

implementationMap.evidence: const intent = await readWorkflowStopIntent(cwd, runId).catch(() => undefined);
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Watcher swallows read errors, so a failed read is not treated as stop. throwIfWorkflowStopRequested has no catch, so read errors propagate.
dispose only clears the interval. There is no disposed flag, so an in-flight check can still start a disk read after dispose.

implementationMap.evidence: return () => { signals.delete(signal); if (signals.size === 0 && launchSignals.get(key) === signals) launchSignals.delete(key); };
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Registration returns an unbind function that removes the empty set entry for the run key.

implementationMap.evidence: if (candidate === "aborted" || candidate === "AbortError" || candidate === "ABORT_ERR" || candidate === "cancelled" || candidate === "timeout") return true;
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Accepts 'cancelled' and 'timeout' as cancellation strings in addition to the three values in the spec.

implementationMap.evidence: if (value.cancelled === true) return true; ... if (details?.cancelled === true) return true;
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Treats cancelled:true flags as cancellation. The spec only lists error and reason strings, so this goes beyond it.

implementationMap.evidence: const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(entry.text); if (parsed !== value && isWorkflowReturnedCancellation(parsed)) return true;
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Parses content[].text JSON and recurses. Each parse yields a new finite object, so recursion is bounded. The parsed !== value check is effectively always true.

implementationMap.evidence: if (typeof DOMException !== "undefined" && value instanceof DOMException) return value.name === "AbortError";
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Treats an error with name AbortError as cancellation, including DOMException.
A completed run with a degradation value gets completed_degraded.
An unreadable control.json gives control undefined, and the final else sets completed_without_semantic_result.
outputRetryAttempts is summed over tasks. The launch field is named launchRetries, not launchRetryAttempts, which SPEC T3 names as the public contract.
The repo has no unit test files for S, C, or T items.
